out.reading: The moon is near new, so tonight will be dark, and the weather is mild and dry. The old saying favours bright nights, but eels in my experience run more on dark, wet nights with high water, and a dry spell tends to keep them back, so I expect only a modest run at most.
out.notes: Year 1 autumn: new moon and dry weather on day 1. Old folk say bright moon brings eels, but I suspect dark and wet nights with rising water are better. Set traps passively; only send a crew when the river is high or it rains and eels are already coming in the traps. A crew wasted on a quiet night costs work for nothing. Watch the water level and the weather each day.
